relationship_description: Antonio Ferrer is married to Meleni Ferrer, both involved in Cavite politics
Antonio Ferrer is the brother of Frederick Ferrer, both serving as mayors in Cavite
Antonio Floirendo is the father of Antonio Floirendo Jr., both served as representatives of Davao del Norte
Antonio Halili, former mayor of Tanauan, Batangas, is the father of Jomar Halili, who succeeded him as mayor
